newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Lepanto seeks tax breaks on gold project.
newsitem.headline: Lepanto seeks tax breaks on gold project.

text.p: Lepanto Consolidated Mining Co is seeking tax and fiscal incentives for its proposed 1.94-billion peso gold project in the country, documents from the Board of Investments (BOI) released on Monday showed.
Lepanto, one of the country's largest copper producers, said it plans to develop a new gold ore deposit. Output from the mine would be made into gold bullion for export, it said.

Of its proposed 1.94-billion peso capital expenditure, the firm said it has earmarked 537 million pesos for the acquisition of mining equipment, 503 million pesos for the development of the mine site and 306 million pesos for the acquisition of milling equipment.
Lepanto said it plans to build a mill with a processing capacity of 3,000 tonnes of ore per day at the site.
Commercial operations of the mine is scheduled to start June 1997, it said.
